invariants: development and evaluation partitions are nonempty disjoint and frozen
evaluation outcomes never train or tune the CATE model or policy threshold
the causal forest uses honest tree splitting and cross-fitted nuisance models
all effect modifiers are pretreatment and the source identification contract is qualified outside the adapter
GATE intervals use a frozen group family and simultaneous Bonferroni coverage
Qini AUTOC BLP and calibration use the independent evaluation partition
candidate policy value is evaluated against treat-all treat-none and a frozen current policy
policy threshold is supplied by the frozen contract and is never optimized on evaluation outcomes
heterogeneity support and policy support use separately frozen acceptance thresholds
a small p-value with a negative ranking coefficient cannot support positive heterogeneity
no row-level CATE is emitted and no score is described as an individual true effect
capacity cost fairness and deployment decisions remain with the business owner
